author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕುಳಿತು ಚರ್ಚೆಯಮಾಡು ಮತಭೇದ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸೆ
ತಿಳಿಗೊಳಿಸು ದ್ವೇಷಮನ ಒಳಸುಳಿಯನರಿತು
ಅಳವಡಿಸೆ ಮಂಥನದೆ ಉದಿಸಿರುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳ
ಉಳಿಸುವೆಯೊ ಏಕತೆಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Sit down and talk it through to heal differences of opinion;
calm the mind full of hatred by understanding its undercurrents;
if you put into practice what emerges from churning it over,
you will preserve unity, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Disagreements are best settled by sitting together and talking. Understand what lies beneath the anger, act on what the discussion brings up, and unity survives.
